label: Aquinas on intrinsic knowability and the scope of incomprehensibility
summary: ST I q.12 a.1 co. grounds intrinsic knowability in actuality. Q.12 a.7 co. excludes exhaustive cognition of God by a created intellect even with its finite elevation. It allows genuine attainment, and the created scope does not exclude divine self-comprehension.
blocker: Supply or justify a common preorder for the measured inequality and identify whether the scope of all non-INFINITE_1 intellects tracks finite created cognition. The source gives the qualitative and divine cases.
